description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Products API in the Fineract project, including response and request schemas for product types, charges, currencies, and related entities.

classes.name: ProductsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for product-related API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetProductsTypeProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed product type response including currency, charges, market price, and accounting info.

classes.name: GetProductsTypeResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of product types.

classes.name: PostProductsTypeRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new product type, including market price periods, charges, and other attributes.

classes.name: PostProductsTypeResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a product type, mainly resource ID.

classes.name: PutProductsTypeProductIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating product description and unit price.

classes.name: PutProductsTypeProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a product, including resource ID and changes.
